candidate.answerReason: Lisa needs at least 40 A grades, so she needs 18 A grades among the remaining 20 quizzes. This allows at most 2 lower grades.

methods.label: Count the required A grades
methods.explanation:
Her percentage goal applies to all \(50\) quizzes, so she needs at least
\[
0.80\cdot 50=40
\]
A grades for the year. There are \(50-30=20\) quizzes remaining.

Let \(x\) be the number of remaining quizzes on which she earns a grade below an A. Then she earns \(20-x\) more A grades, so her goal requires
\[
22+(20-x)\ge 40.
\]
Thus \(42-x\ge40\), giving \(x\le2\). Earning \(18\) more A grades and \(2\) lower grades gives exactly \(40\) A grades, so this bound is attainable. The maximum is \(\boxed{2}\), choice B.
